in_text_mentions: tion demonstrated duodenal obstruction with situs anomaly, and intraoperative assessment revealed non-rotation without pathological fixation or a narrow mesenteric pedicle. Because the mesentery was already broadly based, no Ladd procedure or additional mesenteric widening was required. Laparoscopic duodenoduodenostomy was therefore performed without major technical modification (Figure 3).
